evidence.title: GitHub - assistant-ui/assistant-ui: Typescript/React Library for AI Chat

name: assistant-ui
summary: Open-source TypeScript/React library of composable primitives for building AI chat interfaces.
description: Primitives such as Thread, Message, Composer, ThreadList and ActionBar let you assemble a chat UI from parts, or start from a shadcn/ui theme that the CLI copies into your project. Runtimes connect to the Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph/LangChain, AG-UI, A2A and custom backends; streaming, attachments, markdown, code highlighting, voice dictation and accessibility are handled for you. Generative UI renders tool calls as React components with inline human approvals. MIT licensed, with an optional paid Assistant Cloud.
contains: composable chat primitives: Thread, Message, Composer, ThreadList, ActionBar
runtime adapters for Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph/LangChain, AG-UI, A2A, Google ADK and custom data streams
streaming, auto-scroll, retries, attachments, markdown, code highlighting, voice dictation, keyboard shortcuts
generative UI: tool calls and JSON rendered as React components with inline human approvals
CLI scaffolds a Next.js app or adds styled components to an existing project
MIT license; optional Assistant Cloud for thread persistence and analytics
